attributes.description: Defines the scope at which the discount is applied: entire order, individual item, menu category, or combo meal.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Classification of the discount mechanism applied to the order or item.

attributes.name: final_price
attributes.description: The final price after the discount was applied to the item or order.

attributes.name: is_pre_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount was pre-approved through a promotional campaign (true) or applied as an exception at the Point of Sale (false).

attributes.name: is_stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this discount can be combined with other discounts on the same order or item.

attributes.name: is_voided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this discount was voided or removed from the order after initial application.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed to obtain this discount. Null if discount is not loyalty-based.

attributes.name: max_discount_amount
attributes.description: The maximum allowable discount amount for this promotion or discount type, as configured in the promotion rules.

attributes.name: min_purchase_amount
attributes.description: The minimum order subtotal required to qualify for this discount.

attributes.name: original_price
attributes.description: The original price of the item or order subtotal before the discount was applied.

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the item or order subtotal. Null if discount is a fixed amount.

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation or reason code for the discount, particularly for manager comps and exception-based adjustments.

attributes.name: revenue_impact_amount
attributes.description: The calculated impact of this discount on gross revenue for Profit and Loss (P&L) reporting and Same-Store Sales (SSS) analysis.

attributes.name: tax_treatment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the discount is applied before tax calculation, after tax calculation, or results in a tax-exempt transaction.

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: The date and time when this discount record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: The start date from which this discount or promotion is valid and can be applied.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: The end date after which this discount or promotion is no longer valid.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for why the discount was voided. Null if discount was not voided.

attributes.name: voided_at
attributes.description: The date and time when the discount was voided or removed from the order. Null if discount was not voided.

products.name: refund
products.description: Captures refund and void transactions issued against a completed or in-progress guest order. Records refund reason (wrong item, quality complaint, missing item, guest dissatisfaction), refund amount, refund method (original tender, gift card, loyalty points), authorizing manager, refund timestamp, and whether the refund was full or partial. Supports CSAT root-cause analysis and exception management.

attributes.name: refund_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the refund transaction. Primary key for the order_refund product.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or supervisor who approved and authorized the refund transaction.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Posts refund amounts to a specific GL account to reflect refund expense in financials.

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original guest order against which this refund was issued. Links to the parent order transaction.

attributes.name: guest_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest who received the refund, if known and captured in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.

attributes.name: pos_terminal_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) terminal or workstation where the refund was processed.

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest who received the refund, if known and captured in the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.

attributes.name: refund_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the manager or supervisor who approved and authorized the refund transaction.

attributes.name: refund_processing_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Front of House (FOH) employee who processed the refund transaction at the Point of Sale (POS).

attributes.name: refund_voided_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who voided or reversed the refund transaction.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the refund was processed.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the refund was processed.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value refunded to the guest, including tax adjustments.

attributes.name: approved_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was approved by the authorizing manager.

attributes.name: batch_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the financial batch in which this refund was grouped for accounting reconciliation and settlement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI) Batch Processing

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the refund was initiated and processed, indicating the customer touchpoint.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the refund record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csat_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this refund is associated with a Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) incident requiring follow-up or root-cause analysis.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the refund was issued.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: Time-of-day segment during which the original order and refund occurred, used for operational and sales analysis.

attributes.name: fraud_review_notes
attributes.description: Internal notes from fraud review or investigation related to this refund transaction.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the refund transaction was posted to the General Ledger (GL) for financial reporting.

attributes.name: guest_contact_method
attributes.description: Method by which the guest communicated the refund request or complaint to the restaurant.

attributes.name: is_fraudulent
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this refund was flagged as potentially fraudulent during review or audit.

attributes.name: is_voided
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this refund transaction was subsequently voided or reversed.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_refunded
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points returned to the guest as part of the refund, if applicable.

attributes.name: nps_survey_sent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Promoter Score (NPS) Survey Sent Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a Net Promoter Score (NPS) survey was sent to the guest following the refund.

attributes.name: order_channel
attributes.description: Service channel through which the original order was placed, retained for refund analysis by channel.

attributes.name: original_payment_method
attributes.description: Payment method used in the original order transaction, retained for reconciliation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: payment_processor_ref
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment processor for the refund transaction, used for reconciliation with payment gateway.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code categorizing the primary reason for issuing the refund. Used for root-cause analysis and Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) improvement initiatives. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wrong_item|quality_complaint|missing_item|guest_dissatisfaction|order_error|temperature_issue|allergy_concern|long_wait_time|incorrect_price|duplicate_charge|other — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text detailed explanation of the refund reason provided by the manager or customer service representative.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which the refund value was returned to the guest, indicating the tender type used for reimbursement.

attributes.name: refund_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique refund transaction number displayed on receipts and used for customer service tracking.

attributes.name: refund_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the refund transaction indicating processing state.

attributes.name: refund_type
attributes.description: Classification indicating whether the refund covers the entire order or only specific items.

attributes.name: refunded_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund transaction was completed and funds were returned to the guest.

attributes.name: requested_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was initially requested by the guest or identified by staff.

attributes.name: subtotal
attributes.description: Pre-tax amount of the refund, representing the base value of items or services refunded.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax portion of the refund amount, calculated based on applicable sales tax rates.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 334 - Tax Guide for Small Business

attributes.name: third_party_delivery_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party delivery service provider if the original order was fulfilled through Third-Party Delivery (3PD).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the refund record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the refund transaction was voided or reversed.

attributes.name: voided_at
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was voided or reversed, if applicable.

products.name: sos_target
products.description: Reference entity defining brand-mandated Speed of Service (SOS) targets segmented by service channel, daypart, and restaurant format (QSR, casual, fine-dining). Captures daypart definitions (name, start time, end time, category — breakfast, lunch, dinner, late night), target ticket time in seconds, target total order time, channel applicability, effective date range, and whether the target is a brand standard or local operational goal. Serves as the authoritative daypart and SOS benchmark reference for KDS ticket compliance evaluation, drive-thru SOS benchmarking, PMIX time-of-day analysis, ATC/ACV benchmarking, and labor scheduling alignment.
products.reference: Brand SOS Standard / NRA Speed of Service Benchmark

attributes.name: sos_target_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Speed of Service target record.

attributes.name: brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand (QSR, casual, fine-dining) for which this SOS target is defined.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant location to which this SOS target applies. May be null if the target is a brand-wide standard.

attributes.name: superseded_by_target_sos_target_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SOS target that supersedes this target. Null if this is the current active target.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant location to which this SOS target applies. May be null if the target is a brand-wide standard.

attributes.name: applies_to_order_type
attributes.description: The order type to which this SOS target applies: dine_in, takeout, delivery, or all order types.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the person who approved this SOS target for operational use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SOS target was approved for operational use.

attributes.name: compliance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The minimum percentage of orders that must meet this SOS target for the restaurant to be considered compliant (e.g., 85.00 means 85% of orders must meet the target).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SOS target record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: The daypart (time segment of the day) to which this SOS target applies: breakfast, lunch, dinner, late_night, or all_day.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SOS target expires or is superseded by a new target. Null indicates an open-ended target.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this SOS target becomes effective and should be used for performance evaluation.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SOS target is currently active and should be used for performance measurement and KDS compliance evaluation.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for SOS target times: seconds or minutes. Typically seconds for QSR and fast-casual, minutes for fine-dining.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the person who last modified this SOS target record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SOS target record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions for this SOS target.

attributes.name: peak_hours_only
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SOS target applies only during peak hours (true) or throughout the entire daypart (false).

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The priority level of this SOS target for operational compliance and performance evaluation: critical, high, medium, or low.

attributes.name: restaurant_format
attributes.description: The restaurant format type to which this SOS target applies: QSR (Quick-Service Restaurant), casual, fine_dining, fast_casual, or food_court.

attributes.name: service_channel
attributes.description: The service channel to which this SOS target applies: DT (Drive-Thru), counter (Front of House counter service), OLO (Online Ordering), 3PD (Third-Party Delivery), catering, or kiosk.

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the SOS target, used for external reference and reporting (e.g., DT_LUNCH_QSR, COUNTER_DINNER_CASUAL).

attributes.name: target_handoff_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target time in seconds from order ready (on KDS) to order handoff to guest or delivery driver.

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for the SOS target (e.g., Drive-Thru Lunch Target, Counter Service Dinner Target).

attributes.name: target_queue_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target time in seconds a guest should wait in queue before placing an order, applicable to counter and drive-thru channels.

attributes.name: target_ticket_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target time in seconds from order placement to order ready on the Kitchen Display System (KDS), representing the kitchen preparation speed target.

attributes.name: target_total_order_time_seconds
attributes.description: The target total time in seconds from order placement to order fulfillment (handed to guest or delivered), representing the complete Speed of Service (SOS) target.

attributes.name: target_type
attributes.description: Classification of the SOS target: brand_standard (corporate-mandated), local_goal (restaurant-specific operational goal), franchise_goal (franchisee-defined target), or regulatory (mandated by health or safety regulations).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: The version number of this SOS target, incremented each time the target is revised or updated.

attributes.name: warning_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The percentage threshold below which a warning alert is triggered for operational management (e.g., 80.00 triggers a warning if compliance falls below 80%).

attributes.name: weather_adjusted
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SOS target should be adjusted based on adverse weather conditions that impact throughput.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the person who created this SOS target record.

products.name: tax
products.description: Records tax line details applied to a guest order, supporting multi-jurisdiction tax compliance. Captures tax authority (federal, state, county, city), tax type (sales tax, VAT, beverage tax, bag fee), tax rate, taxable amount, tax amount, and whether the tax was included in the menu price or added at checkout. Supports financial reconciliation and regulatory tax reporting across all restaurant locations.
products.reference: Oracle MICROS Tax Detail / GAAP Tax Reporting

attributes.name: tax_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax line record applied to a guest order. Primary key for the order_tax data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Ensures tax liabilities from each order are posted to the correct tax GL account for compliance and reporting.

attributes.name: guest_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent guest order to which this tax line belongs. Establishes the header-to-line relationship between guest_order and order_tax.

attributes.name: site_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the order was placed. Used to resolve the applicable tax jurisdiction and for location-level financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant location where the order was placed. Used to resolve the applicable tax jurisdiction and for location-level financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: adjusted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when a post-transaction tax adjustment was applied to this line. Populated only when tax_status = 'adjusted'. Supports audit trail for tax corrections.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Adjustment; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for a post-transaction tax adjustment when tax_status = 'adjusted' (e.g., rate_correction, jurisdiction_change, exemption_applied, refund, audit_correction, other). Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; IRS Audit Requirements; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The computed tax amount for this tax line in the transaction currency (taxable_amount × tax_rate, or as overridden by the tax engine). Core field for financial reconciliation, P&L reporting, and tax remittance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; IRS Publication 334; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX

attributes.name: applied_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line was computed and applied to the order by the tax engine or POS system. Represents the principal business event time for this tax line record.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Transaction Log; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX

attributes.name: authority_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the tax authority or jurisdiction as defined by the tax engine or ERP (SAP S/4HANA Tax Condition). Used for automated tax remittance and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Configuration; Vertex Tax Engine

attributes.name: authority_level
attributes.description: The governmental jurisdiction level that imposes this tax line. Supports multi-jurisdiction tax compliance across all restaurant locations. Values: federal, state, county, city, district, special.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; State Revenue Codes; Local Tax Ordinances

attributes.name: authority_name
attributes.description: The full name of the tax authority or jurisdiction imposing this tax (e.g., 'California State Board of Equalization', 'Cook County Revenue Department', 'City of Chicago'). Used for regulatory reporting and remittance.
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Registries; IRS

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA cost center code associated with the restaurant location for this tax line. Used for internal cost allocation, P&L reporting by location, and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Cost Center Accounting; GAAP/IFRS Management Reporting

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the tax jurisdiction (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'GBR'). Required for international operations, VAT compliance, and cross-border tax reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IFRS IAS 12; VAT Directive 2006/112/EC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail field for data lineage and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this tax line (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'GBP'). Required for multi-currency operations and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: daypart
attributes.description: The meal period or daypart during which the order was placed (breakfast, lunch, dinner, late_night, snack). Used for daypart-level tax and revenue analysis in foodservice operations.
attributes.references: NRA Daypart Reporting Standards; Oracle MICROS POS Daypart Configuration

attributes.name: engine_source
attributes.description: Identifies the system or engine that calculated and applied this tax line (e.g., pos = Oracle MICROS POS built-in tax, vertex = Vertex O Series, avalara = Avalara AvaTax, sap_tax = SAP S/4HANA tax engine, manual = manually entered). Used for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Tax Configuration; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; Vertex O Series

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier of the tax exemption certificate presented by the guest or organization. Required for audit documentation when is_exempt is True. Null when no exemption applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 557; State Revenue Authority Exemption Certificate Requirements

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for a tax exemption when is_exempt is True (e.g., government, non_profit, resale, diplomatic, employee_meal, other). Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance. Null when is_exempt is False.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exemption Guidelines; State Revenue Codes; FTC Franchise Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: is_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax line was flagged as exempt (True) due to a guest exemption certificate, government order, or qualifying non-profit status. When True, tax_amount should be zero and exemption_reason should be populated.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Exemption Guidelines; State Revenue Codes; USDA Exemption Rules

attributes.name: is_refunded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax amount on this line has been refunded to the guest (True) as part of an order refund or cancellation. Used for refund reconciliation and tax reversal tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Refund Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Reversal; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: is_tax_inclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax was already included in the menu price (True) or added at checkout on top of the menu price (False). Critical for VAT/GST jurisdictions and for accurate revenue recognition and tax remittance calculations.

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential number ordering multiple tax lines within the same order (e.g., 1 = state sales tax, 2 = county tax, 3 = city beverage tax). Ensures deterministic ordering for receipt display and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Tax Line Sequencing; NRA Receipt Standards

attributes.name: order_channel
attributes.description: The service channel through which the order was placed (pos = in-store Point of Sale, drive_thru = Drive-Thru (DT), olo = Online Ordering (OLO), third_party_delivery = Third-Party Delivery (3PD), kiosk = self-service kiosk, catering). Used for channel-level tax analysis and compliance.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; Olo Digital Ordering Platform; NRA Channel Reporting Standards

attributes.name: original_tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount as originally computed at the time of order placement, before any post-transaction adjustments. Populated when tax_status = 'adjusted' to preserve the audit trail of the original calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; IRS Audit Requirements

attributes.name: period_date
attributes.description: The business date (yyyy-MM-dd) to which this tax line is attributed for tax remittance and financial period reporting. May differ from the transaction timestamp for end-of-day batch processing or period adjustments.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; IRS Tax Period Rules

attributes.name: pos_tax_line_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Point of Sale (POS) Tax Line Reference
attributes.description: The native tax line identifier or sequence number assigned by Oracle MICROS POS for this tax entry. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the POS transaction log and the lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Tax Transaction Log

attributes.name: rate
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.0875 for 8.75%). Sourced from the tax engine or POS tax configuration at the time of the transaction. Used for tax amount validation and audit.
attributes.references: State and Local Tax Authority Rate Tables; SAP S/4HANA Tax Condition Records

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount refunded to the guest when is_refunded is True. May be a partial refund (less than tax_amount) for partial order refunds. Used for financial reconciliation and tax reversal reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Refund Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: remittance_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (e.g., '2024-Q1', '2024-03') in which this tax amount is scheduled for remittance to the tax authority. Used for tax filing calendar management and period-end close.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Filing Calendar; State Revenue Authority Filing Schedules; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax amount has been remitted to the applicable tax authority (pending = not yet remitted, remitted = successfully paid to authority, not_applicable = exempt or zero-rate, failed = remittance attempt failed). Supports tax compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Tax Remittance Requirements; State Revenue Authority Filing Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX

attributes.name: sap_tax_document_ref
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA FI-TX tax document number associated with this tax line for GL posting and tax remittance. Enables end-to-end traceability from POS transaction to ERP financial posting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Document; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this tax line record originated (micros_pos = Oracle MICROS POS, sap_s4hana = SAP S/4HANA FI-TX, olo = Olo Digital Ordering Platform, manual = manually entered). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS; SAP S/4HANA; Olo Digital Ordering Platform; Internal Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (or equivalent provincial code) of the tax jurisdiction where the restaurant is located (e.g., 'IL', 'CA', 'TX'). Used for state-level tax rate lookup, remittance routing, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ANSI INCITS 38; IRS State Tax Authority Codes; State Revenue Departments

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The internal or POS-assigned tax code identifying the specific tax rule applied (e.g., 'TX_CA_SALES', 'TX_CHI_BEV'). Maps to the tax condition record in SAP S/4HANA and Oracle MICROS POS tax configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Tax Condition Records; Oracle MICROS POS Tax Configuration

attributes.name: tax_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tax as displayed on the guest receipt or financial report (e.g., 'Illinois Sales Tax', 'Chicago Beverage Tax', 'CA Bag Fee'). Required for receipt compliance and guest transparency.
attributes.references: NRA Receipt Compliance Guidelines; State Consumer Protection Laws

attributes.name: tax_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this tax line record. 'applied' = tax successfully computed and applied; 'voided' = tax line cancelled due to order void; 'adjusted' = tax amount corrected post-transaction; 'pending' = awaiting tax engine resolution; 'reversed' = tax reversed for refund.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Tax Document Status; Oracle MICROS POS Void Processing

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: The category of tax applied to this line (e.g., sales_tax, vat, beverage_tax, bag_fee, excise_tax, service_tax). Supports differentiated tax reporting and compliance across jurisdictions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sales_tax|vat|beverage_tax|bag_fee|excise_tax|service_tax|surcharge|environmental_fee — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling Regulations; State Revenue Codes; IRS Publication 334

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the order subtotal that is subject to this specific tax line, expressed in the transaction currency. Excludes non-taxable items, exempt amounts, and tax-inclusive components. Used for tax calculation validation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IRS Publication 334; State Revenue Codes

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental loads, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX) when this tax line was voided, if applicable. Populated only when tax_status = 'voided'. Used for void audit trail and financial reversal processing.
attributes.references: Oracle MICROS POS Void Processing; SAP S/4HANA FI-TX Reversal

products.name: order_ingredient_usage
products.description: Association between order_item and stock_item that records the amount of each inventory item consumed by a specific line item, including cost and waste information. Each record links one order_item to one stock_item with attributes that exist only in the context of this consumption.. Existence Justification: Each order line (order_item) consumes one or more inventory stock items (ingredients) and each stock item can be consumed by many order lines. The restaurant tracks the quantity used, unit cost, waste flag and waste reason for every such consumption to support costing, waste analysis and traceability. This relationship is actively created and maintained by the kitchen and back‑office systems.

attributes.name: order_ingredient_usage_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the ingredient_usage association

attributes.name: order_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the order line item

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the inventory stock item

attributes.name: quantity_used
attributes.description: Amount of the stock item consumed by the order line

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Cost per unit of the stock item at the time of consumption

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity used (e.g., grams, ounces)

attributes.name: waste_flag
attributes.description: Indicates if the consumed quantity was recorded as waste

attributes.name: waste_reason
attributes.description: Reason for waste (e.g., spoilage, over‑prep)

products.name: catering_package
products.description: Master reference table for catering_package. Referenced by catering_package_id.

attributes.name: catering_package_id
attributes.description: Primary key for catering_package

attributes.name: availability_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the catering package is no longer available for ordering.

attributes.name: availability_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the catering package becomes available for ordering.

attributes.name: calories
attributes.description: Total calories per serving of the catering package.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Manages end-to-end food and non-food supply chain including supplier master data, vendor management, sourcing, purchase orders, inbound logistics, distribution center operations, and ingredient traceability. Tracks COGS, supplier performance, contract compliance, and spend analytics via Coupa Procurement.
domains.references: ISO 22000, USDA Grading Standards, GMP, Coupa Procurement

products.name: supply_supplier
products.description: Master record for every supplier and vendor in the foodservice supply chain, including food and non-food suppliers, distributors, co-manufacturers, and their key contacts. Captures supplier identity, classification (broadline, specialty, local), approval status, diversity certification, payment terms, lead times, regulatory compliance status (FDA, USDA, HACCP), and primary/secondary contact information. SSOT for supplier identity and contact details across supply chain operations. Sourced from Coupa Procurement supplier master and SAP S/4HANA vendor master (MM).
products.reference: SAP Vendor Master (LFA1), Coupa Supplier Record

attributes.name: supply_supplier_id

products.name: ingredient
products.description: Master catalog of all food ingredients, raw materials, beverages, and packaging SKUs procured across the foodservice supply chain. Captures SKU code, ingredient name, commodity category, unit of measure, allergen flags (Big 9), USDA grade, country of origin, shelf life days, storage temperature requirements (ambient/refrigerated/frozen), and HACCP critical control classification. Serves as the supply-side item master linking to menu domain BOM for recipe costing. SSOT for ingredient identity across supply, inventory, and menu domains. Sourced from SAP MM material master and MarketMan Inventory Management.

Represents the contractual commitment to buy. Sourced from Coupa Procurement PO module and SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing.

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Transactional record of inbound goods received at a distribution center or restaurant, including both header-level receipt information and line-level detail per SKU. Header captures receipt date/time, receiving location, PO reference, receiving condition, and inspector ID. Lines capture specific ingredient/SKU received, quantity accepted/rejected, lot number, expiration date, temperature at receipt (cold chain compliance), storage location assigned, and variance from PO quantity. Critical for three-way match (PO-receipt-invoice), HACCP traceability, and ingredient-level lot tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM (MIGO) and MarketMan receiving module.

products.name: supplier_performance
products.description: Periodic scorecard record evaluating supplier performance against foodservice supply chain KPIs: on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate, case fill rate, order accuracy, quality rejection rate, invoice accuracy, food safety audit score, and cold chain compliance. Captures measurement period (weekly/monthly/quarterly), composite scorecard rating (preferred, approved, conditional, probationary, suspended), corrective action plan (CAP) flag, and next review date. Used for quarterly business reviews (QBRs), contract renewal decisions, and approved vendor list status changes.

attributes.description: Delivery terms and conditions (e.g., FOB, CIF)

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard lead time in days for deliveries under the contract

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: Agreed unit price for supplied items under this contract

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Manages BOH stock levels, SKU tracking, PAR levels (Periodic Automatic Replenishment), waste tracking (Waste%), yield management, receiving, transfers, physical counts, and replenishment orders via MarketMan. Supports COGS% optimization and food cost control across all restaurant units.
domains.references: HACCP, ISO 22000, MarketMan Inventory Management SOP

products.name: stock_item
products.description: Master record for every SKU tracked in restaurant inventory — food, beverage, packaging, and non-food supplies. Captures SKU code, item name, unit of measure (UOM), item category (protein, produce, dry goods, beverage, paper goods, cleaning), storage class (ambient, refrigerated, frozen), reorder point, reorder quantity, standard cost, vendor item code, shelf life days, HACCP temperature range, allergen flags, daypart applicability, seasonal adjustment flags, and active status. Also owns PAR-level configuration per unit-location: PAR quantity, minimum quantity (reorder point), maximum quantity (shelf capacity), day-of-week overrides, seasonal adjustment flags, and effective date range. This is the SSOT for all stockable items and their replenishment parameters managed through MarketMan.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock item. Primary key for the stock_item product.

attributes.name: category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_category. Business justification: Aligns each inventory item with its procurement category for spend analysis and budgeting.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Allows allocation of inventory holding costs to specific cost centers for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for financial reporting of inventory valuation and COGS per item, enabling accurate GL posting of stock costs.

attributes.name: ingredient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.ingredient. Business justification: REQUIRED: Ingredient Inventory Valuation Report needs each stock item linked to its ingredient master for nutrition, allergen, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: item_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.item_specification. Business justification: Required for Item Specification compliance reports linking each stock item to its defined specification for FDA/USDA audits.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred supplier for this stock item. Links to vendor master data in procurement system.

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred supplier for this stock item. Links to vendor master data in procurement system.

attributes.name: allergen_eggs
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain eggs. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_fish
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain fish. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_milk
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain milk or dairy derivatives. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_peanuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain peanuts. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_shellfish
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain crustacean shellfish. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_soybeans
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain soybeans. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_tree_nuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain tree nuts. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: allergen_wheat
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains or may contain wheat. Required for menu labeling and allergen disclosure.

attributes.name: case_pack_quantity
attributes.description: Number of individual units contained in one case. Used for ordering and receiving conversions.

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the standard cost (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock item record was first created in the inventory management system.

attributes.name: discontinuation_date
attributes.description: Date when the item was or will be discontinued from inventory. Used for phase-out planning and historical analysis.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: International product identifier used for supply chain tracking and barcode scanning. May be UPC, EAN, or other GS1 format.

attributes.name: haccp_max_temp_f
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Maximum Temperature Fahrenheit
attributes.description: Maximum safe storage temperature in Fahrenheit to maintain product quality and food safety standards.

attributes.name: haccp_min_temp_f
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) Minimum Temperature Fahrenheit
attributes.description: Minimum safe storage temperature in Fahrenheit required to prevent bacterial growth and ensure food safety compliance.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stock item is currently available for ordering and use. Inactive items are retained for historical reporting but not available for new transactions.

attributes.name: is_gluten_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified gluten-free or naturally contains no gluten. Critical for dietary accommodation and menu labeling.

attributes.name: is_gmo_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified non-GMO. Used for menu transparency and consumer preference alignment.

attributes.name: is_halal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item meets Islamic dietary law requirements. Used for menu segmentation and cultural accommodation.

attributes.name: is_kosher
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item meets Jewish dietary law requirements. Used for menu segmentation and cultural accommodation.

attributes.name: is_organic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is certified organic according to USDA standards. Used for menu marketing and premium pricing.

attributes.name: is_vegan
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains no animal products or by-products. Used for menu filtering and dietary preference alignment.

attributes.name: is_vegetarian
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item contains no meat, poultry, or seafood. Used for menu filtering and dietary preference alignment.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the stock item by food service category. Used for inventory organization, COGS analysis, and procurement planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: protein|produce|dairy|dry_goods|beverage|paper_goods|cleaning|packaging — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the stock item including brand, size, packaging, and other distinguishing characteristics.

attributes.name: item_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the stock item as it appears in inventory management and ordering systems.

attributes.name: item_subcategory
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within the item category (e.g., beef, chicken, lettuce, tomato).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the stock item record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: par_level
attributes.description: Target inventory quantity that should be maintained at all times to support operational needs without overstocking. Used for automated reorder triggers.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Inventory threshold quantity that triggers a replenishment order. Set below PAR level to account for lead time.

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard quantity to order when inventory falls below reorder point. Calculated to restore inventory to PAR level.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Number of days the item remains usable after receipt. Critical for waste management, FIFO rotation, and food safety compliance.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the stock item across all restaurant units and inventory systems. This is the business identifier used in MarketMan and POS systems.

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Expected unit cost of the item used for COGS calculations and variance analysis. Updated periodically based on procurement contracts.

attributes.name: storage_class
attributes.description: Required storage temperature zone for the item. Determines BOH storage location and HACCP compliance requirements.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit in which the stock item is tracked, ordered, and received. Critical for accurate inventory counts and cost calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|box|bag|dozen — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_item_code
attributes.description: Supplier's unique identifier for this item. Used for purchase order matching and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: yield_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of usable product after preparation and trimming. Critical for recipe costing and waste tracking.

products.name: stock_location
products.description: Master record for every physical storage location within a restaurant unit where inventory is held — walk-in cooler, walk-in freezer, dry storage room, BOH prep area, FOH service station, bar storage. Captures location code, location name, location type (refrigerated, frozen, ambient, bar), temperature zone, capacity (cubic feet or shelf count), restaurant unit reference, and active status. Enables granular stock-on-hand tracking by storage zone.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock location. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Stores overhead allocation of each storage location to cost centers for accurate expense tracking.

attributes.name: distribution_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.distribution_center. Business justification: REQUIRED: DC‑wise stock location reporting and temperature compliance audits require linking each location to its distribution center.

attributes.name: equipment_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the refrigeration or climate control equipment serving this location, used for maintenance tracking and temperature monitoring integration.

attributes.name: equipment_equipment_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the refrigeration or climate control equipment serving this location, used for maintenance tracking and temperature monitoring integration.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.facility. Business justification: Facility‑level inventory mapping needed for inventory valuation and rent‑cost allocation reports per physical restaurant property.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Required for HACCP temperature monitoring accountability; each storage location has an assigned manager employee who signs compliance reports.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where this stock location is physically situated.

attributes.name: access_control_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic or physical access control (keycard, PIN, lock) is required to enter this location.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the stock location was first activated and made available for inventory storage.

attributes.name: allows_receiving
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated as a receiving point for incoming inventory deliveries.

attributes.name: allows_transfers
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory can be transferred into or out of this location to other stock locations within the restaurant or across units.

attributes.name: allows_waste_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether waste events (spoilage, damage, expiration) can be recorded against inventory in this location for Waste% calculation.

attributes.name: bin_count
attributes.description: Number of individual storage bins or compartments within this location for granular SKU organization.

attributes.name: building_section
attributes.description: Specific section or wing of the building where the location is situated (e.g., Kitchen, Bar, Prep Area, Receiving Dock).

attributes.name: capacity_cubic_feet
attributes.description: Total storage capacity of the location measured in cubic feet.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stock location record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled physical inventory cycle counts for this location to maintain stock accuracy.
attributes.references: MarketMan Inventory Management - Cycle Count Policy

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the stock location was deactivated or decommissioned and is no longer available for inventory storage.

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Physical floor level where the storage location is situated (e.g., 1 for ground floor, -1 for basement, 2 for second floor).

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent physical inventory cycle count was completed for this location.
attributes.references: MarketMan Inventory Management - Cycle Count History

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent maintenance or inspection was performed on the storage location or its equipment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the stock location record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the storage location within the restaurant unit (e.g., WIC01 for walk-in cooler 1, DRY02 for dry storage room 2).

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the stock location (e.g., Walk-In Cooler, Dry Storage Room, Bar Storage, Prep Area Shelf).

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the storage location based on its primary function and environmental control (refrigerated, frozen, ambient, bar, prep_area, service_station).

attributes.name: next_scheduled_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the next physical inventory cycle count is scheduled for this location.
attributes.references: MarketMan Inventory Management - Cycle Count Schedule

attributes.name: next_scheduled_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the next scheduled maintenance or inspection is planned for the storage location or its equipment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special handling instructions, or operational notes about the stock location.

attributes.name: par_level_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether PAR level inventory management is enabled for this location to trigger automatic replenishment orders.
attributes.references: MarketMan Inventory Management - PAR Level Configuration

attributes.name: primary_commodity_category
attributes.description: Primary category of inventory items typically stored in this location (e.g., Proteins, Dairy, Produce, Dry Goods, Beverages, Alcohol).

attributes.name: requires_haccp_monitoring
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requires HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) Monitoring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location requires HACCP monitoring and documentation for food safety compliance.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification for the location indicating access control requirements (open: unrestricted, restricted: authorized staff only, locked: key/code required, high_value: premium items with enhanced security).

attributes.name: shelf_count
attributes.description: Number of shelves or storage levels available in this location for organizing inventory.

attributes.name: stock_location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the stock location (active: in use, inactive: temporarily not in use, maintenance: under repair, decommissioned: permanently retired).

attributes.name: storage_area_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: Storage Area Type (Back of House / Front of House)
attributes.description: Indicates whether the location is in Back of House (BOH) or Front of House (FOH) area of the restaurant.

attributes.name: target_temperature_max_f
attributes.description: Maximum target temperature in Fahrenheit for this storage location to maintain food safety and quality standards.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - Temperature Control Requirements

attributes.name: target_temperature_min_f
attributes.description: Minimum target temperature in Fahrenheit for this storage location to maintain food safety and quality standards.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - Temperature Control Requirements

attributes.name: temperature_monitoring_frequency_hours
attributes.description: Required frequency in hours for temperature checks and logging at this location to ensure food safety compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control classification for the location (freezer: below 0°F, cooler: 32-40°F, ambient: room temperature, controlled: climate-controlled but not refrigerated).
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - Temperature Control Requirements

products.name: on_hand_balance
products.description: Current stock-on-hand snapshot for each SKU at each storage location within a restaurant unit. Captures quantity on hand, quantity reserved (committed to prep), quantity available, last physical count date, last adjustment date, last received date, unit cost, extended value, and variance from PAR level. Updated by receiving, transfers, waste events, and physical counts. The authoritative real-time inventory position record used for replenishment decisions and food cost reporting.

attributes.name: on_hand_balance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the on-hand balance record. Primary key for the inventory position snapshot.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Links on‑hand quantities to cost centers to reflect inventory value in financial statements per cost center.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.facility. Business justification: On‑hand snapshots need facility context for real‑estate cost allocation, insurance valuation, and property‑level inventory audits.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: FRANCHISEE‑LEVEL INVENTORY DASHBOARD aggregates on‑hand balances per franchisee for performance and royalty calculations.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where this inventory is held. Links to the restaurant operations master.

attributes.name: sku_stock_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this balance is recorded. Links to the inventory item master.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) for which this balance is recorded. Links to the inventory item master.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location within the restaurant (walk-in cooler, dry storage, freezer, prep area). Links to storage location master.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where this inventory is held. Links to the restaurant operations master.

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: The ABC inventory classification based on value and usage velocity. A items are high-value/high-velocity requiring tight control, C items are low-value/low-velocity.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which unit_cost and extended_value are denominated.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which this SKU should be physically counted as part of the cycle count program. Typically aligned with ABC classification.

attributes.name: days_until_expiration
attributes.description: The number of days remaining until the expiration date. Used to prioritize usage and identify items at risk of waste.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date by which this inventory must be used or discarded. Critical for food safety, waste management, and FIFO (First In First Out) rotation.

attributes.name: extended_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of the on-hand inventory, calculated as quantity_on_hand multiplied by unit_cost. Used for financial reporting and COGS% analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this inventory position. Determines whether the inventory is available for use, held for quality review, or flagged for disposal.

attributes.name: is_perishable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SKU is a perishable item requiring temperature control and expiration tracking. True for fresh produce, dairy, meat; false for dry goods.

attributes.name: last_adjustment_date
attributes.description: The date when the last inventory adjustment (waste, transfer, or correction) was recorded for this SKU at this location.

attributes.name: last_movement_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the last inventory transaction (receipt, transfer, issue, or adjustment) that affected this balance. Used to identify stagnant inventory.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: The date when the last physical inventory count was performed for this SKU at this location. Used to track audit compliance and inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: last_received_date
attributes.description: The date when this SKU was last received into inventory at this location. Used to track inventory freshness and identify slow-moving items.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The supplier or manufacturer lot number for traceability and recall management. Critical for food safety compliance under HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points).

attributes.name: par_level
attributes.description: The target inventory level for this SKU at this location, used for automatic replenishment decisions. Represents the optimal stock level to maintain service without excess waste.

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: The net quantity available for use or sale, calculated as quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved. Represents the true available-to-promise inventory.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: The total physical quantity of the SKU currently in stock at this location. Represents the gross inventory position before reservations.

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: The quantity of the SKU that is committed to prep, production, or pending orders and not available for new allocation. Used in BOH (Back of House) prep planning.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this on-hand balance record was first created in the data platform. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this on-hand balance record was last updated in the data platform. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory level at which a replenishment order should be triggered. When quantity_available falls below this threshold, the system generates a purchase order.

attributes.name: safety_stock
attributes.description: The minimum buffer stock maintained to protect against stockouts due to demand variability or supply delays. Part of the PAR level calculation.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The business identifier code for the SKU. Denormalized from SKU master for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: sku_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the SKU. Denormalized from SKU master for reporting convenience.

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this on-hand balance snapshot was captured. Represents the point-in-time inventory position for reporting and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system that provided this inventory balance record (MarketMan Inventory Management, SAP Materials Management, manual physical count, or POS integration).

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: The required storage temperature zone for this SKU (ambient/dry, refrigerated, or frozen). Critical for food safety compliance and storage location assignment.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of measure for this SKU at this location. Used to calculate extended inventory value and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the quantity is expressed (each, pound, kilogram, ounce, gallon, liter, case, box, pack, dozen). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|LB|KG|OZ|GAL|L|CS|BX|PK|DZ — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The accounting method used to value this inventory (FIFO - First In First Out, LIFO - Last In First Out, weighted average, or standard cost). Determines COGS calculation.

attributes.name: variance_from_par
attributes.business_glossary_term: Variance from Periodic Automatic Replenishment (PAR) Level
attributes.description: The difference between quantity_on_hand and par_level. Positive values indicate overstocking, negative values indicate understocking and trigger replenishment.

products.name: receiving_order
products.description: Records the receipt of goods delivered to a restaurant unit from a supplier or distribution center, capturing both delivery-level header information and line-level SKU detail in a single consolidated entity. Header attributes: purchase order reference, delivery date/time, supplier reference, driver name, invoice number, total received value, receiving status (pending/partial/complete/rejected), temperature check result, seal integrity check, and receiving manager reference. Line attributes (one per SKU received): stock item reference, ordered vs received vs rejected quantities, unit of measure, unit cost, extended cost, lot number, expiration date, temperature at receipt (°F/°C), condition code (acceptable/damaged/short-dated/rejected), and variance reason code. Links to MarketMan purchase order and SAP S/4HANA goods receipt. Drives on-hand balance updates, COGS% tracking, and supplier performance measurement.

attributes.name: receiving_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the receiving order record. Primary key for inbound inventory transactions at restaurant unit level.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the restaurant manager or BOH staff member who inspected and accepted the delivery. Links to Workday HCM employee master.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.facility. Business justification: Receiving dock assignment per facility supports labor‑cost tracking and health‑inspection compliance at each restaurant location.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Franchisee receiving reports track supplier deliveries per franchisee to reconcile costs against royalty fees.

attributes.name: procurement_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating purchase order in MarketMan that authorized this delivery. Links receiving to procurement.

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or distribution center that delivered the goods. Links to vendor master in Coupa or MarketMan.

attributes.name: receiving_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the restaurant manager or BOH staff member who inspected and accepted the delivery. Links to Workday HCM employee master.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit receiving the goods. Links to restaurant operations master data.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit receiving the goods. Links to restaurant operations master data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the receiving order record was first created in MarketMan or source system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the received value (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-currency operations for international franchise units.

attributes.name: days_variance
attributes.description: Calculated difference in days between expected and actual delivery date. Positive values indicate late delivery; negative values indicate early delivery. Used for supplier scorecard.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the goods were delivered to the restaurant unit. Used for inventory aging and FIFO tracking.

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Packing slip or delivery note number provided by the supplier. Cross-reference document for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: delivery_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the delivery was received at the restaurant Back of House (BOH). Critical for temperature control compliance and HACCP documentation.

attributes.name: delivery_timeliness
attributes.description: Classification of delivery punctuality relative to expected delivery date. On Time: within agreed window; Early: before window; Late: after window. Key supplier performance indicator.

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Name of the driver who delivered the goods. Captured for traceability and food safety audit trail per HACCP requirements.

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: Scheduled delivery date from the original purchase order. Used to calculate delivery timeliness and supplier on-time performance metrics.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) goods receipt document number generated when receiving is posted to inventory. Used for three-way match and financial posting.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number provided by the supplier on the delivery documentation. Used for three-way match with PO and goods receipt in SAP S/4HANA AP.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the receiving order record was last updated. Tracks changes to status, variance resolution, or quality inspection updates.

attributes.name: posted_to_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that received goods have been posted to restaurant unit inventory in MarketMan and SAP S/4HANA. True when goods receipt is complete and stock levels updated.

attributes.name: posted_to_inventory_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the receiving transaction was posted to inventory system. Used for inventory valuation date and FIFO/LIFO costing.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_result
attributes.description: Overall quality assessment result for the received goods. Approved: meets standards; Rejected: fails quality criteria; Conditional: accepted with notes; Not Inspected: visual check only. Aligns with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards.

attributes.name: quality_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by receiving manager regarding product quality, packaging condition, or other observations. Used for supplier feedback and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: receiving_location
attributes.description: Physical location at the restaurant unit where goods were received. Typically Back of House (BOH) loading area. Used for operational logistics and security tracking.

attributes.name: receiving_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique receiving document number generated by MarketMan or restaurant POS system. Format: RCV-YYYYMMDD-NNNN.

attributes.name: receiving_shift
attributes.description: Operational shift during which the delivery was received. Used for labor planning and to ensure adequate BOH staffing for receiving activities.

attributes.name: receiving_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the receiving transaction. Pending: awaiting inspection; Partial: some items received; Complete: fully received and accepted; Rejected: delivery refused; Disputed: discrepancy under review.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if receiving status is rejected. Captures specific food safety, quality, or compliance failure that led to refusal of delivery. Required for FDA and HACCP audit trail.
attributes.references: HACCP Corrective Action, FDA Food Code

attributes.name: seal_integrity_check
attributes.description: Verification that tamper-evident seals on delivery containers were intact upon arrival. Intact: seal unbroken; Broken: potential contamination risk; Not Applicable: no seal required. Part of food safety protocol.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this receiving record. MarketMan: primary inventory system; SAP MM: ERP goods receipt; Manual Entry: paper-based receiving logged retrospectively.

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Legal or trade name of the supplier or distributor. Denormalized for reporting convenience; authoritative source is supplier master.

attributes.name: temperature_check_result
attributes.description: Result of temperature verification for refrigerated and frozen goods upon delivery. Pass: within safe range; Fail: out of range, reject or quarantine; Not Applicable: ambient goods. Critical for HACCP and FDA compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code, HACCP Critical Control Point

attributes.name: temperature_recorded
attributes.description: Actual temperature reading in Fahrenheit recorded during delivery inspection for refrigerated or frozen items. Null for ambient goods. Used for food safety audit trail.

attributes.name: total_items_ordered
attributes.description: Total count of distinct Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) listed on the originating purchase order. Used for completeness verification.

attributes.name: total_items_received
attributes.description: Total count of distinct SKUs actually received and accepted in this transaction. Variance from total_items_ordered triggers partial or disputed status.

attributes.name: total_received_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of all goods received in this transaction, in local currency. Used for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation and variance analysis against PO.

attributes.name: variance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator that quantity or value variance exists between PO and received goods. True triggers exception workflow for manager review and supplier follow-up.

attributes.name: variance_reason
