attributes.description: Shipment tracking number provided by carrier for the replenishment order. Enables real-time delivery status monitoring.

attributes.name: variance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the received replenishment order had discrepancies (quantity, quality, or item substitutions) compared to the original order. True if variance detected.

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes describing any discrepancies found during receiving. Includes short shipments, damaged goods, wrong items, or quality issues. Used for supplier dispute resolution.

products.name: yield_record
products.description: Captures actual yield measurements from food preparation activities — the ratio of usable output to raw input for a given recipe component or prep task. Captures prep date, stock item (raw ingredient), prep type (butchering, portioning, cooking, trimming), raw quantity in, usable yield quantity out, waste quantity, yield percentage (actual vs. standard), prep station, and recorded-by employee. Supports yield management, BOM accuracy validation, and COGS% optimization by identifying yield gaps versus recipe standards.

attributes.name: yield_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the yield record. Primary key.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Yield analysis is reported to franchisees to drive operational efficiency and cost control.

attributes.name: primary_yield_recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who recorded the yield measurement.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recipe or BOM (Bill of Materials) associated with this prep task, if applicable.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where the yield measurement was recorded.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the raw ingredient or stock item that was processed.

attributes.name: actual_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Actual yield percentage calculated as (usable_yield_quantity_out / raw_quantity_in) * 100. Represents the efficiency of the prep process.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number of the raw ingredient used, for traceability and HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) compliance.

attributes.name: cost_per_raw_unit
attributes.description: Cost per unit of the raw ingredient at the time of preparation. Used to calculate actual prep cost and COGS% impact.

attributes.name: cost_per_yield_unit
attributes.description: Calculated cost per unit of usable yield output, accounting for waste. Used for accurate BOM costing and menu pricing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the yield record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: haccp_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the preparation activity met HACCP critical control point requirements (temperature, time, sanitation).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the yield record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments about the yield measurement, prep conditions, or any anomalies observed.

attributes.name: prep_date
attributes.description: Date when the food preparation activity and yield measurement occurred.

attributes.name: prep_station_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the BOH (Back of House) prep station or work area where the preparation occurred.

attributes.name: prep_station_name
attributes.description: Name of the BOH prep station or work area (e.g., Butcher Station, Salad Prep, Grill Station).

attributes.name: prep_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the food preparation activity was completed and yield was recorded.

attributes.name: prep_type
attributes.description: Type of food preparation activity performed (e.g., butchering, portioning, cooking, trimming, peeling, deboning).
attributes.references: Internal BOH (Back of House) Operations Standard

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade assigned to the usable yield output (e.g., A for premium, B for standard, C for acceptable, reject for unusable).

attributes.name: raw_quantity_in
attributes.description: Quantity of raw ingredient input into the preparation process.

attributes.name: raw_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the raw ingredient quantity (e.g., lb, kg, oz, each, case).

attributes.name: recipe_component_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific recipe component or prep task within the BOM (e.g., Trimmed Chicken Breast, Diced Onions).

attributes.name: standard_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Standard or expected yield percentage defined in the recipe or BOM (Bill of Materials) for this prep task.

attributes.name: temperature_at_prep_f
attributes.description: Temperature of the ingredient or environment at the time of preparation, in Fahrenheit. Relevant for HACCP monitoring.

attributes.name: total_raw_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the raw ingredient used in this prep activity (raw_quantity_in * cost_per_raw_unit).

attributes.name: usable_yield_quantity_out
attributes.description: Quantity of usable output produced from the preparation process after waste removal.

attributes.name: waste_percentage
attributes.description: Waste percentage calculated as (waste_quantity / raw_quantity_in) * 100. Key metric for COGS% (Cost of Goods Sold Percentage) optimization.

attributes.name: waste_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of waste generated during the preparation process (trim, bones, spoilage, etc.).

attributes.name: waste_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the primary reason for waste (e.g., trim, spoilage, overcooking, contamination, quality issue).

attributes.name: waste_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the waste reason or circumstances.

attributes.name: waste_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the waste quantity (e.g., lb, kg, oz).

attributes.name: yield_record_status
attributes.description: Current status of the yield record in the review workflow (draft, verified, approved, rejected).

attributes.name: yield_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the usable yield quantity (e.g., lb, kg, oz, portion, each).

attributes.name: yield_variance_percentage
attributes.description: Variance between actual and standard yield percentage (actual_yield_percentage - standard_yield_percentage). Positive indicates better-than-expected yield; negative indicates yield loss.

products.name: inventory_adjustment
products.description: Records manual adjustments to on-hand inventory balances outside of standard receiving, waste, or count workflows. Captures adjustment date, adjustment type (positive adjustment, negative adjustment, write-off, theft, breakage, system correction), stock item reference, storage location, adjusted quantity, adjustment value ($), reason code, supporting document reference, adjusted-by employee, and manager approval. Provides a complete audit trail for all non-standard inventory movements and supports shrinkage analysis.

attributes.name: inventory_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory adjustment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who reviewed and approved the inventory adjustment.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.facility. Business justification: Adjustment entries need facility reference for GL posting and COGS allocation to the correct restaurant building.

attributes.name: foodsafety_corrective_action_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to foodsafety.corrective_action. Business justification: Inventory adjustments may result from corrective actions issued after audits; the FK records the originating action.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Adjustments affect COGS and royalty calculations; franchisee‑level tracking is required for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Ensures inventory adjustments affect the correct GL account for accurate COGS and inventory valuation.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_adjusted_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who initiated and recorded the inventory adjustment transaction.

attributes.name: primary_inventory_physical_count_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical inventory count record that triggered this adjustment, if the adjustment resulted from a count reconciliation.

attributes.name: related_receiving_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving transaction that this adjustment corrects, if the adjustment is a receiving correction.

attributes.name: related_receiving_receiving_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving transaction that this adjustment corrects, if the adjustment is a receiving correction.

attributes.name: related_stock_transfer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory transfer transaction that this adjustment corrects, if the adjustment is a transfer correction.

attributes.name: related_transfer_stock_transfer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory transfer transaction that this adjustment corrects, if the adjustment is a transfer correction.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where the inventory adjustment occurred.

attributes.name: reversal_adjustment_inventory_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the adjustment record that reversed this adjustment, if applicable.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stock keeping unit (SKU) being adjusted.

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location (walk-in, dry storage, freezer) where the adjusted inventory is held.

attributes.name: adjusted_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of inventory adjusted, expressed in the stock item's unit of measure. Positive values indicate increases to on-hand inventory; negative values indicate decreases.

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the inventory adjustment was recorded and applied to on-hand balances.

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the inventory adjustment transaction. Format: ADJ-YYYYMMDD-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: adjustment_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the inventory adjustment transaction was recorded in the system.

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inventory adjustment indicating the nature of the non-standard inventory movement (positive adjustment, negative adjustment, write-off, theft, breakage, spoilage, system correction, transfer correction, count reconciliation, damaged goods, expired product, vendor credit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: positive adjustment|negative adjustment|write-off|theft|breakage|spoilage|system correction|transfer correction|count reconciliation|damaged goods|expired product|vendor credit — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: adjustment_value
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the inventory adjustment, calculated as adjusted quantity multiplied by unit cost. Positive values increase inventory asset value; negative values decrease it.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the inventory adjustment (pending, approved, rejected, auto-approved).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the manager approved the inventory adjustment.

attributes.name: approved_by_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager who approved the inventory adjustment, captured for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number of the stock item being adjusted, used for traceability and food safety compliance under Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code associated with the restaurant unit or department responsible for the inventory adjustment, used for Profit and Loss (P&L) allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory adjustment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the adjustment value (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-by date of the stock item being adjusted, relevant for adjustments due to expired product removal.

attributes.name: impacts_cogs
attributes.business_glossary_term: Impacts Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory adjustment impacts the restaurant unit's Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) percentage calculation.

attributes.name: is_reversed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this inventory adjustment has been reversed by a subsequent correcting adjustment.

attributes.name: is_shrinkage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment represents inventory shrinkage (unexplained loss, theft, or discrepancy between physical count and system records).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this inventory adjustment record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments providing context, details, or special instructions related to the inventory adjustment.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity_after
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity for this stock item at this location immediately after the adjustment was applied.

attributes.name: on_hand_quantity_before
attributes.description: The on-hand inventory quantity for this stock item at this location immediately before the adjustment was applied.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the specific business reason for the adjustment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: THEFT|DAMAGE|SPOIL|EXPIRE|RECOUNT|SYSCORR|XFERERR|VNDCRED|BREAK|SPILL|MISREC|OVERPOUR|PORTIONERR|TEMPFAIL|RECALL — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing detailed explanation of why the inventory adjustment was necessary.

attributes.name: requires_approval
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment type or value threshold requires manager approval before being applied to inventory balances.

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for supporting documentation (e.g., incident report number, physical count sheet ID, vendor credit memo number, manager approval form) that justifies the adjustment.

attributes.name: temperature_at_adjustment_f
attributes.description: The recorded storage temperature in Fahrenheit at the time of adjustment, relevant for temperature-related spoilage or HACCP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - HACCP Temperature Controls

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of the stock item at the time of adjustment, used to calculate the total adjustment value.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the adjusted quantity is expressed (each, case, pound, kilogram, ounce, liter, gallon, box, bag, pallet). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: each|case|pound|kilogram|ounce|liter|gallon|box|bag|pallet — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waste_category
attributes.description: Classification of waste type for adjustments related to inventory loss, used for waste percentage (Waste%) tracking and analysis (operational waste, spoilage, theft, damage, other).

products.name: food_cost_period
products.description: Period-level food cost summary record for each restaurant unit, capturing the calculated COGS% for a defined accounting period (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly). Captures period start date, period end date, opening inventory value ($), purchases value ($), transfers-in value ($), transfers-out value ($), waste value ($), closing inventory value ($), theoretical food cost ($), actual food cost ($), COGS% actual, COGS% theoretical, variance ($), and variance percentage. The operational food cost control record — NOT an analytics aggregate but the posted period-close record used by restaurant managers and finance.

attributes.name: food_cost_period_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the food cost period record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who reviewed and approved this food cost period record. Typically a district manager, area director, or finance controller.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Food‑cost period calculations consider campaign impact on COGS; linking provides the necessary data for cost‑impact reports.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Links periodic food‑cost calculations to cost centers for departmental profitability reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who closed and finalized this food cost period. Typically a restaurant manager or accounting staff member.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Food‑cost period statements are aggregated per franchisee for royalty and performance scorecards.

attributes.name: primary_food_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who closed and finalized this food cost period. Typically a restaurant manager or accounting staff member.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit for which this food cost period is calculated. Links to the specific restaurant location.

attributes.name: actual_food_cost
attributes.description: The actual Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) for the period, calculated as: Opening Inventory + Purchases + Transfers In - Transfers Out - Closing Inventory. The real food cost incurred.
attributes.references: GAAP Cost of Goods Sold Standards

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any manual adjustments applied to the food cost calculation for the period, such as corrections for inventory errors, vendor credits, or accounting reclassifications. Positive or negative value.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any manual adjustment applied to the food cost calculation. Provides audit trail and justification for period adjustments.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period was reviewed and approved by management. Indicates final sign-off on the period results.

attributes.name: beverage_sales_revenue
attributes.description: The total beverage sales revenue for the period. Tracked separately from food sales for category-specific cost analysis.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period was officially closed and calculations were finalized. Marks the completion of the period-close process.

attributes.name: closing_inventory_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of food inventory on hand at the end of the period, determined by physical count or perpetual inventory system. Represents the ending stock value for COGS calculation.

attributes.name: cogs_percent_actual
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Percentage Actual
attributes.description: The actual food cost as a percentage of food sales revenue for the period. Key performance metric for restaurant profitability and cost control. Calculated as (Actual Food Cost / Food Sales Revenue) * 100.

attributes.name: cogs_percent_theoretical
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Percentage Theoretical
attributes.description: The theoretical food cost as a percentage of food sales revenue for the period. Represents the ideal COGS% if all operational standards were met. Calculated as (Theoretical Food Cost / Food Sales Revenue) * 100.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine closing inventory value: physical (manual count), perpetual (system-tracked), or hybrid (system with periodic physical verification).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period record was first created in the system. Marks the initiation of the period tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international restaurant chains.

attributes.name: food_sales_revenue
attributes.description: The total food sales revenue (excluding beverage) for the period. Used as the denominator in COGS% calculations. Sourced from Point of Sale (POS) system.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this food cost period record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this food cost period, such as unusual events, operational issues, inventory discrepancies, or explanations for variance. Used for management review and audit purposes.

attributes.name: opening_inventory_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of food inventory on hand at the beginning of the period. Represents the starting stock value for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) calculation.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the accounting period for which food costs are being calculated. Marks the close of the cost accumulation window.

attributes.name: period_number
attributes.description: The accounting period identifier in format YYYY-PNN (e.g., 2024-P01 for period 1 of 2024). Used for financial reporting alignment.

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the accounting period for which food costs are being calculated. Marks the beginning of the cost accumulation window.

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: The current status of the food cost period: open (still accepting transactions), closed (period ended, calculations complete), locked (finalized, no further changes allowed), or under_review (being audited or reviewed).

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The frequency type of the accounting period for food cost calculation (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly).

attributes.name: physical_count_date
attributes.description: The date on which the physical inventory count was performed to determine closing inventory value. Typically the last day of the period or the first day of the next period.

attributes.name: purchases_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of all food and beverage purchases received during the period. Includes all vendor invoices posted to inventory during the period.

attributes.name: theoretical_food_cost
attributes.description: The calculated ideal food cost based on recipe costing and actual sales mix (PMIX). Represents what food cost should have been if all recipes were followed perfectly with no waste or theft.

attributes.name: total_sales_revenue
attributes.description: The combined food and beverage sales revenue for the period. Represents total top-line revenue for the restaurant unit during the period.

attributes.name: transfers_in_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of inventory transferred into this restaurant unit from other locations during the period. Increases available inventory.

attributes.name: transfers_out_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of inventory transferred out of this restaurant unit to other locations during the period. Decreases available inventory.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The dollar difference between actual food cost and theoretical food cost (Actual - Theoretical). Positive variance indicates higher-than-expected costs due to waste, theft, portioning errors, or recipe non-compliance.

attributes.name: variance_percent
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of theoretical food cost. Calculated as (Variance Amount / Theoretical Food Cost) * 100. Used to assess the magnitude of cost control issues.

attributes.name: waste_percent
attributes.description: The waste value as a percentage of total food usage (Waste Value / (Actual Food Cost + Waste Value)) * 100. Key metric for food quality control and operational efficiency.

attributes.name: waste_value
attributes.description: The total dollar value of food waste recorded during the period, including spoilage, expiration, preparation errors, and quality control discards. Tracked for Waste% calculation and food cost control.

products.name: uom
products.description: Reference master for all units of measure used in inventory transactions — ordering UOM, storage UOM, and recipe UOM — plus their conversion factors. Captures UOM code, UOM name, UOM type (weight/volume/count/length), base UOM flag, and applicable item categories. Conversion detail: from-UOM, to-UOM, stock-item-specific overrides (item-specific conversions override global defaults), conversion factor, effective date, and source (vendor spec/lab measurement/standard). Supports accurate translation between ordering (case of 6), storage (each), and recipe (ounce/gram) contexts — critical for inventory valuation and COGS% calculation across all restaurant units.

attributes.name: uom_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the unit of measure. Primary key.

attributes.name: base_uom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the base UOM for this measurement type. Used to establish conversion chains. Null if this UOM is itself the base unit.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Short form or symbol for the UOM (e.g., lb, oz, gal, kg, g, ml). Used in compact displays, labels, and Kitchen Display System (KDS) screens.

attributes.name: allows_fractional_quantities
attributes.description: Indicates whether fractional quantities are permitted for this UOM (e.g., 2.5 pounds allowed, but 2.5 cases may not be). Enforces business rules in inventory transactions and recipe scaling.

attributes.name: allows_temperature_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether items measured in this UOM require Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) temperature monitoring during storage and transfer. Supports food safety compliance per Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations.

attributes.name: applicable_item_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) categories or commodity types where this UOM is applicable (e.g., dry goods, produce, dairy, beverages, proteins). Supports context-aware UOM selection in ordering and recipe management.

attributes.name: conversion_factor_to_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Conversion Factor to Base Unit of Measure (UOM)
attributes.description: Multiplier to convert this UOM to the base UOM (e.g., 1 pound = 453.592 grams, so conversion_factor_to_base = 453.592). Critical for accurate Cost of Goods Sold (COGS%) calculation and yield management across ordering, storage, and recipe contexts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this UOM record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking per Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) requirements.

attributes.name: default_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Default shelf life in days for items measured in this UOM. Used as a fallback when Stock Keeping Unit (SKU)-specific shelf life is not defined. Supports waste tracking (Waste%) and First In First Out (FIFO) rotation.

attributes.name: display_sequence
attributes.description: Sort order for displaying UOMs in user interfaces and dropdown lists. Lower numbers appear first. Supports user experience optimization in Point of Sale (POS) and inventory management systems.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this UOM was retired or deprecated. Null for currently active UOMs. Supports historical reporting and audit trails for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS%) analysis.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this UOM became available for use in inventory transactions. Supports temporal validity and historical analysis of UOM changes.

attributes.name: is_base_uom
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is Base Unit of Measure (UOM) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is the base unit for its type (e.g., gram for weight, milliliter for volume). Base UOMs have a conversion factor of 1.0 and serve as the reference for all conversions within their type.

attributes.name: is_system_standard
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is a system-defined standard (e.g., gram, liter, each) that cannot be modified or deleted by users. Protects core reference data integrity.

attributes.name: iso_code
attributes.description: ISO 80000 standard code for the unit of measure. Supports international operations and regulatory compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this UOM record was last updated. Supports change tracking and data governance for Cost of Goods Sold (COGS%) accuracy and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, usage guidelines, or special handling instructions for this UOM. Supports operational documentation and training materials.

attributes.name: ordering_uom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in purchase orders and vendor ordering (e.g., case, pallet). Supports procurement workflows and vendor catalog integration.

attributes.name: plural_name
attributes.description: Plural form of the UOM name (e.g., Pounds, Ounces, Cases). Supports grammatically correct reporting and user interface text generation.

attributes.name: precision_decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places to use when displaying or calculating quantities in this UOM. Ensures consistent rounding and precision across inventory transactions.

attributes.name: recipe_uom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used in recipe Bill of Materials (BOM) and menu item costing (e.g., ounce, gram, tablespoon). Critical for accurate recipe yield management and menu engineering.

attributes.name: requires_lot_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether items measured in this UOM require lot number and expiration date tracking for traceability. Supports food safety recalls and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) compliance.

attributes.name: storage_uom_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this UOM is used for Back of House (BOH) inventory storage and stock tracking (e.g., each, bag, box). Supports Periodic Automatic Replenishment (PAR) level management and cycle counts.

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Standard international symbol for the UOM (e.g., °F, °C, %, #). Used in scientific and regulatory contexts, particularly for Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP) temperature monitoring.

attributes.name: un_cefact_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Centre for Trade Facilitation and Electronic Business (UN/CEFACT) Code
attributes.description: Standardized UN/CEFACT Recommendation 20 code for the unit of measure. Supports Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integration with suppliers and third-party logistics providers.

attributes.name: uom_category
attributes.description: Measurement system category (metric, imperial, count-based, or custom). Supports multi-region operations with different measurement standards.

attributes.name: uom_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the unit of measure (e.g., EA, CS, LB, OZ, GAL, KG, G, ML, L). Used as the business identifier in inventory transactions and recipe management.

attributes.name: uom_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the unit of measure (e.g., Each, Case, Pound, Ounce, Gallon, Kilogram, Gram, Milliliter, Liter). Human-readable label for reporting and user interfaces.

attributes.name: uom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the UOM. Active UOMs are available for use in transactions; deprecated UOMs are retained for historical data but not available for new transactions.

attributes.name: uom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the unit of measure by dimension type. Determines conversion logic and applicability to different inventory contexts (receiving, storage, recipe). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weight|volume|count|length|area|temperature|time — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: vendor_item
products.description: Maps each stock item to the supplier(s) that provide it, capturing the supplier-specific item details used in ordering and receiving. Captures supplier reference, stock item reference, supplier item code (vendor SKU), supplier item description, order UOM, pack size, pack quantity, current unit cost, contract price flag, lead time days, minimum order quantity, preferred vendor flag, and active status. Enables multi-vendor sourcing for critical items and supports cost comparison and replenishment order generation. Distinct from the procurement domain's supplier master — this is the inventory-domain view of what each vendor supplies.
products.reference: MarketMan Vendor Item / Supplier Item Catalog

attributes.name: vendor_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor item mapping record. Primary key.

attributes.name: expense_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Maps vendor items to expense GL accounts for automated AP posting and cost tracking.

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier that provides this stock item. Links to the procurement domain's supplier master.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stock item (SKU) in the inventory master that this vendor supplies.

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.supplier_contract. Business justification: REQUIRED: Procurement audit needs to know which supplier contract governs each vendor‑supplied item for pricing and compliance.

attributes.name: vendor_procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier that provides this stock item. Links to the procurement domain's supplier master.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: The date when this vendor item mapping became active and available for ordering.

attributes.name: contract_effective_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract pricing becomes effective for this vendor item.

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract pricing expires for this vendor item.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the procurement contract governing this vendor item pricing, if applicable.

attributes.name: contract_price_flag

attributes.name: cost_currency_code

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code indicating where this item is produced or sourced by the vendor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|CHN|BRA|ARG|AUS|NZL|GBR|FRA|DEU|ITA|ESP|JPN|KOR|THA|VNM|IND — 18 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this vendor item mapping record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: The date when this vendor item mapping was deactivated or discontinued, if applicable.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for deactivating this vendor item mapping (e.g., vendor discontinued, better pricing found, quality issues).

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: The vendor's GTIN/UPC/EAN barcode for this item, used for receiving and inventory tracking.

attributes.name: last_cost_update_date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this vendor item mapping record was most recently updated.

attributes.name: last_order_date

attributes.name: last_received_date
attributes.description: The most recent date when this item was received from this vendor.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between order placement and expected delivery from this vendor for this item.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the actual manufacturer of this item, which may differ from the vendor/distributor.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's unique part or item number for this product.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity (in order UOM) that must be ordered from this vendor for this item.

attributes.name: next_cost_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next cost review or renegotiation with this vendor for this item.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional information, special handling instructions, or vendor-specific requirements for this item.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of orders for this vendor item that were delivered within the promised lead time window.

attributes.name: order_increment

attributes.name: order_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure used when ordering this item from the vendor (e.g., case, pound, gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|LB|KG|GAL|LTR|OZ|BOX|BAG|CASE|PALLET|EACH — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pack_quantity
attributes.description: The number of individual packs or units contained in one order UOM (e.g., 12 cans per case, 4 bags per box).

attributes.name: pack_size
attributes.description: The size or weight of each individual pack or unit within the order UOM (e.g., '5 LB', '12 OZ', '1 GAL').

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is the preferred supplier for this stock item (True) or an alternate source (False).

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Quality score for this vendor's supply of this item, typically on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00, based on receiving inspections and quality audits.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The current cost per order UOM from this vendor. Used for purchase order generation and COGS calculation.

attributes.name: vendor_brand_name
attributes.description: The brand name under which the vendor supplies this item, if applicable.

attributes.name: vendor_item_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the item from the vendor's catalog, including specifications, grade, or quality attributes.

attributes.name: vendor_item_name
attributes.description: The supplier's product name or description for this item as it appears in their catalog.

attributes.name: vendor_item_status
attributes.description: Current status of this vendor item mapping in the system lifecycle.

attributes.name: vendor_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of this vendor for this item when multiple vendors supply the same SKU (1=first choice, 2=second choice, etc.).

attributes.name: vendor_product_category
attributes.description: The vendor's classification or category for this item in their catalog structure.

attributes.name: vendor_sku
attributes.description: The supplier's unique item code or SKU for this product. Used in purchase orders and receiving documents.

products.name: lot_tracking
products.description: Tracks lot numbers and expiration dates for received inventory items requiring traceability — particularly proteins, produce, dairy, and allergen-containing items. Captures lot number, stock item reference, supplier reference, receiving order reference, received date, manufacture date, expiration date, quantity received, quantity remaining, storage location, recall flag, and quarantine status. Supports HACCP traceability requirements, FDA recall response, and FIFO/FEFO rotation compliance.

attributes.name: lot_tracking_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the lot tracking record. Primary key for traceability of inventory items requiring lot-level tracking per HACCP and FDA requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - Traceability Rule

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.facility. Business justification: Lot traceability per facility is required for recall management and compliance with local health regulations.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Lot tracking per franchisee supports recall management and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: ingredient_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.ingredient_lot. Business justification: REQUIRED: Full traceability for recalls and HACCP requires linking lot tracking records to the master ingredient lot entity.

attributes.name: primary_lot_received_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who physically received and logged this lot into inventory. Establishes accountability for receiving procedures.

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier who provided this lot. Critical for recall response and supplier quality tracking.

attributes.name: receiving_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the receiving order through which this lot was received into inventory. Establishes chain of custody for traceability.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the restaurant unit where this lot is stored. Enables location-specific recall response and FIFO/FEFO rotation management.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the stock item (SKU) being tracked. Links to the master inventory item requiring lot-level traceability.
attributes.references: MarketMan Inventory Management - Stock Item Master

attributes.name: stock_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific storage location (cooler, freezer, dry storage) where this lot is currently stored. Enables temperature zone compliance and physical inventory management.

attributes.name: allergen_eggs
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains eggs or egg derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_fish
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains fish or fish derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_milk
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains milk or milk derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_peanuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains peanuts or peanut derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_shellfish
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains shellfish or shellfish derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_soybeans
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains soybeans or soy derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_tree_nuts
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains tree nuts or tree nut derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: allergen_wheat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot contains wheat or wheat derivatives. Required for allergen traceability and customer safety.
attributes.references: FDA FALCPA - Major Food Allergen Labeling

attributes.name: best_by_date
attributes.description: Date by which product quality is optimal. Distinct from expiration date; used for quality management and customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: condition_at_receiving
attributes.description: Assessment of lot condition when received. Documents any quality issues or deviations requiring corrective action.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lot tracking record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this lot should not be used or sold. Drives FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation and waste prevention.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lot tracking record was last updated. Tracks changes to quantity remaining, status, or other attributes for audit purposes.

attributes.name: lot_code
attributes.description: Alternative or supplementary lot code used by supplier or manufacturer. May include production facility codes or batch identifiers.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer or supplier assigned lot number for this batch of product. Primary traceability identifier required by FDA for recall response and HACCP compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule - Lot Identification

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this lot. Controls whether lot can be used in production and triggers workflow actions for recalls or quality holds.

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date when this lot was manufactured or produced by the supplier. Critical for shelf life calculation and quality assurance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Labeling - Date Marking Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes capturing additional lot information, quality observations, or special handling instructions. Supports audit trail and operational communication.

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade assigned to this lot at receiving. Used for yield management and menu item assignment decisions.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Original quantity of this lot received into inventory. Baseline for tracking consumption and remaining quantity.

attributes.name: quantity_remaining
attributes.description: Current quantity of this lot still in inventory. Updated as lot is consumed through production or transferred. Enables real-time lot depletion tracking.

attributes.name: quarantine_date
attributes.description: Date when lot was placed on quarantine hold. Starts clock for resolution and disposition decision.

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is quarantined pending quality review or investigation. Prevents use in production until released.

attributes.name: quarantine_reason
attributes.description: Reason for quarantine hold (e.g., temperature deviation, quality defect, documentation issue). Drives corrective action workflow.

attributes.name: recall_date
attributes.description: Date when recall was initiated for this lot. Triggers immediate quarantine and customer notification procedures.

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is subject to an active recall. When true, lot must be quarantined and reported per FDA recall procedures.

attributes.name: recall_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for recall (e.g., allergen contamination, pathogen detection, foreign material). Critical for risk assessment and customer communication.

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date when this lot was physically received into the restaurant unit. Used for FIFO/FEFO rotation and shelf life calculations.

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when this lot was received and logged into inventory. Provides audit trail for time-sensitive traceability requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_at_receiving_f
attributes.description: Product temperature measured at time of receiving. HACCP critical control point for verifying cold chain integrity.

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature control zone where this lot must be stored. Critical for food safety compliance and HACCP monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - Temperature Control Requirements

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for quantities in this lot record. Standardized across receiving and inventory tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|LB|KG|OZ|GAL|L|CS|BX|PK|DZ — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: prep_usage
products.description: Records the consumption of raw ingredients during BOH food preparation activities — the actual ingredient usage pulled from inventory to fulfill prep tasks and production schedules. Captures prep date, shift, station, stock item consumed, quantity used, unit of measure, theoretical usage (from BOM/recipe), actual usage, variance quantity, variance value ($), prep task reference, and recorded-by employee. Bridges inventory depletion with recipe/BOM standards from the menu domain, enabling theoretical vs. actual COGS% comparison.
products.reference: Ingredient Usage / BOH Consumption / Theoretical vs Actual

attributes.name: prep_usage_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the prep usage record. Primary key for the prep usage transaction.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to realestate.facility. Business justification: Prep usage reporting per facility allows analysis of labor efficiency and yield performance for each restaurant property.

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to franchise.franchisee. Business justification: Prep usage data is allocated to franchisees for labor and ingredient cost attribution.

attributes.name: primary_prep_recorded_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who recorded the prep usage transaction. Supports accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: recipe_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recipe or BOM (Bill of Materials) that defines the theoretical ingredient usage. Links to the menu domain recipe master.

attributes.name: restaurant_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the restaurant unit where the prep activity occurred. Links to the restaurant operations domain.

attributes.name: stock_item_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the raw ingredient or stock item consumed during prep. Links to the inventory stock item master.

attributes.name: actual_cost
attributes.description: The total dollar cost of the actual quantity used (actual_quantity_used multiplied by unit_cost). Contributes to actual COGS% (Cost of Goods Sold Percentage).

attributes.name: actual_quantity_used
attributes.description: The actual quantity of the ingredient consumed during prep, as recorded by the BOH (Back of House) team. This is the real-world usage that depletes inventory.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The internal batch or production run number assigned to the prep output. Links multiple ingredient pulls to a single production batch.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this prep usage record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Supports multi-currency operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-by date of the ingredient lot consumed. Ensures FIFO (First In First Out) compliance and food safety.

attributes.name: haccp_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the prep activity met HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) temperature and handling requirements. True if compliant, False if not.

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: The description of the stock item consumed. Denormalized to preserve historical context even if the item master changes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this prep usage record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number of the ingredient consumed. Critical for traceability and food safety compliance under HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the prep usage transaction. Captures contextual information for variance investigation or operational insights.

attributes.name: prep_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the prep activity occurred. Used for daily food cost tracking and COGS% (Cost of Goods Sold Percentage) analysis.

attributes.name: prep_station_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the BOH (Back of House) prep station where the ingredient was consumed. Examples include grill, fry, salad, bakery, or assembly.

attributes.name: prep_station_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the prep station. Provides context for operational reporting and training.

attributes.name: prep_task_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or identifier for the specific prep task or production batch. Used to group related ingredient pulls for a single prep activity.

attributes.name: prep_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the prep activity was performed. Enables shift-level and intra-day analysis of BOH (Back of House) production.

attributes.name: prep_type
attributes.description: The type or purpose of the prep activity. Distinguishes between batch production, made-to-order, PAR (Periodic Automatic Replenishment) level restocking, and other prep scenarios.

attributes.name: prep_usage_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the prep usage record. Supports workflow management and data quality controls.

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: The quality grade assigned to the prep output. Used to track prep quality and identify training or process improvement needs.

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The operational shift during which the prep activity occurred. Supports labor and production efficiency analysis by daypart. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: opening|morning|lunch|afternoon|dinner|closing|overnight — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) code of the ingredient consumed. Denormalized for reporting convenience and historical accuracy.

attributes.name: temperature_at_prep_f
attributes.description: The temperature in Fahrenheit at which the ingredient was stored or handled during prep. Critical for HACCP (Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points) compliance.

attributes.name: theoretical_cost
attributes.description: The total dollar cost of the theoretical quantity (theoretical_quantity multiplied by unit_cost). Used for theoretical COGS% calculation.

attributes.name: theoretical_quantity
attributes.description: The theoretical quantity of the ingredient that should have been used according to the recipe or BOM (Bill of Materials). Used for variance analysis.

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: The cost per unit of measure for the ingredient at the time of prep. Used to calculate the dollar value of usage and variance.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantity used. Examples include lb, kg, oz, gal, L, ea (each), case, or portion.

attributes.name: variance_cost
attributes.description: The dollar value of the variance (actual_cost minus theoretical_cost). Quantifies the financial impact of over- or under-usage.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance quantity expressed as a percentage of the theoretical quantity. Enables standardized comparison across different ingredients and recipes.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between actual and theoretical quantity used (actual minus theoretical). Positive values indicate over-usage; negative values indicate under-usage.

attributes.name: waste_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for any waste or over-usage. Used to categorize and analyze sources of food waste and variance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|spillage|over_prep|quality_issue|expiration|contamination|equipment_failure|training_error — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: item_category
products.description: Master reference table for item_category.

attributes.name: item_category_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the item category. Primary key for the item category reference taxonomy.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who performed the last review.

attributes.name: parent_category_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent category in the hierarchical taxonomy. Null for top-level categories. Enables drill-down reporting from major groups to item classes.

attributes.name: primary_item_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who created this category record. Used for audit trail and data governance.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when this category was activated and became available for use. Used for historical analysis and category lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: allergen_category
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category contains items that are major food allergens or allergen-containing ingredients per FDA regulations. Used for allergen management and menu labeling compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA)

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the category scope, including what types of items are classified under this category and any special handling or procurement considerations.

attributes.name: category_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the category within the taxonomy. 1=major group (e.g., Food, Beverage, Non-Food), 2=sub-group (e.g., Protein, Produce), 3=item class (e.g., Beef, Fresh Vegetables).

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: High‑level classification of the category for analytics and cost allocation.

attributes.name: cogs_budget_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) Budget Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target COGS percentage for this category as a percentage of revenue. Used for food cost control, variance analysis, and P&L forecasting. Example: 28.50 represents 28.50% target COGS.

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Storage and handling classification for items in this category. Drives warehouse zoning, PAR level calculations, and waste tracking strategies.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Default cost center code for expense allocation for items in this category. Used for departmental cost tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this category record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard frequency in days for cycle counting items in this category. High-value or high-risk categories have shorter frequencies. Used for inventory accuracy programs.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when this category was deactivated and removed from active use. Null for active categories. Used for historical reporting and compliance.

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for deactivating this category. Examples: consolidated into another category, no longer used, taxonomy restructure. Null for active categories.

attributes.name: default_margin_percent
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage applied to items in this category.

attributes.name: default_par_level_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Default Periodic Automatic Replenishment (PAR) Level Days
attributes.description: Standard PAR level in days of inventory for items in this category. Used to calculate reorder points and optimize stock levels. Varies by commodity type and lead time.
attributes.references: MarketMan Inventory Management - PAR Level Configuration

attributes.name: default_par_quantity
attributes.description: Typical periodic automatic replenishment quantity for the category.

attributes.name: default_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Standard shelf life in days for items in this category. Used as default for new item setup and for automated expiration date calculations. Null for non-perishable categories.

attributes.name: default_tax_rate_percent
attributes.description: Standard sales tax rate applicable to the category.

attributes.name: default_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for items in this category. Examples: LB (pounds), EA (each), CS (case), GAL (gallon), KG (kilogram). Used as default for new item setup.

attributes.name: default_waste_percent
attributes.description: Expected waste percentage for the category used in cost modeling.

attributes.name: division
attributes.description: Top-level division to which this category belongs. Used for high-level financial reporting and procurement segmentation.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date when the category becomes valid for use.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date when the category is retired; null if still active.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default GL account code for COGS postings for items in this category. Used for automated financial posting and P&L reporting integration with SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: haccp_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether HACCP monitoring is mandatory for items in this category.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Depth of the category in the hierarchy (root = 0).

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this category is currently active and available for use. Inactive categories are retained for historical reporting but cannot be assigned to new items.

attributes.name: is_perishable
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category are perishable and require temperature control.

attributes.name: item_category_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the category purpose and scope.

attributes.name: item_category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the category.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this category record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data processing.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent governance review of the category definition.

attributes.name: multi_sourcing_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category can be sourced from multiple vendors. False for categories requiring single-source consistency (e.g., branded ingredients, proprietary items).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes and comments about this category. Used for special instructions, procurement guidelines, or category-specific business rules.

attributes.name: primary_vendor_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category must have a designated primary vendor. True for strategic categories with negotiated contracts or quality requirements.

attributes.name: procurement_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in days for items in this category. Used for reorder point calculations and supply chain planning.

attributes.name: requires_expiration_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category require expiration date tracking for food safety and waste management. True for perishable and time-sensitive items.
attributes.references: FDA Food Code - Date Marking Requirements

attributes.name: requires_lot_tracking
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category require lot number tracking for traceability and recall management. Typically true for food and beverage categories.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - Traceability Rule

attributes.name: requires_temperature_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether items in this category require temperature-controlled storage and handling per HACCP guidelines. True for perishable, refrigerated, and frozen categories.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Typical number of days items in this category remain usable after receipt.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Display sequence number for this category within its parent level. Used for consistent ordering in reports, menus, and user interfaces.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system that supplied the category record (e.g., "MarketMan").

attributes.name: tax_category_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code for items in this category. Used for sales tax calculation and compliance reporting. Examples: FOOD (tax-exempt food), TAXABLE (standard rate), BEVERAGE (special rate).

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Designated temperature control zone for storage of this category.

attributes.name: typical_waste_category
attributes.description: Most common waste reason for this category.

attributes.name: typical_yield_percentage
attributes.description: Average usable yield percentage for the category during preparation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the category record.

attributes.name: waste_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether waste tracking is enabled for items in this category. True for perishable food categories to support Waste% KPI reporting and food cost optimization.
attributes.references: MarketMan Inventory Management - Waste Tracking Configuration

attributes.name: yield_management_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether yield management is enabled for items in this category. True for categories where as-purchased quantity differs from usable quantity (e.g., whole proteins, produce with trim loss).

attributes.name: parent_item_category_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on item_category (parent_item_category_id)

products.name: inventory_ingredient_usage
products.description: Represents the operational relationship between an ingredient and a franchisee, capturing how much of the ingredient each franchisee consumes on average each month and the cost per unit negotiated for that franchisee.. Existence Justification: Each franchisee uses many different ingredients in its menus, and each ingredient is used across many franchisee locations. The business tracks the average monthly usage and the cost per unit for each ingredient‑franchisee pair to support inventory forecasting and supplier negotiations. This relationship is actively managed and updated on a regular basis.

attributes.name: inventory_ingredient_usage_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the IngredientUsage association

attributes.name: franchisee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the franchisee master

attributes.name: ingredient_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the ingredient master

attributes.name: average_monthly_usage
attributes.description: Average quantity of the ingredient used per month by the franchisee

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Negotiated cost per unit of the ingredient for the franchisee

domains.name: restaurant
domains.description: Master record for every restaurant unit — company-owned and franchised — including location attributes, format (QSR/casual/fine-dining), FOH/BOH configuration, operating hours, daypart schedules, equipment, throughput capacity, speed-of-service (SOS) benchmarks, table turns, cover counts, AUV, SSS, and comp sales. Operational anchor for brand standards and SOPs.
domains.references: NRA Operational Standards, OSHA, Local Health Departments

products.name: unit
products.description: Master record for every restaurant unit — company-owned and franchised. The authoritative identity of each physical location including unit number, brand, concept type (QSR/casual/fine-dining), ownership model (company-owned vs. franchised), legal entity name, trade name, opening date, closure date, current operational status, and geographic coordinates. This is the operational anchor for the entire restaurant domain and the primary FK target for all cross-domain joins (order, inventory, workforce, finance, franchise). One row per physical restaurant location. All other restaurant domain products reference this entity.

attributes.name: unit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the restaurant unit. Primary key for the unit master record.

attributes.name: brand_id

products.name: format_config
products.description: Defines the operational format, physical configuration, and total capacity of a restaurant unit. Includes dining format (QSR, fast-casual, casual, fine-dining), service model (counter, table, drive-thru, kiosk), FOH layout (total indoor seating capacity, outdoor/patio seating capacity, bar seating count, private dining room capacity, ADA-compliant seating count, table count, cover count), BOH layout (kitchen footprint sq ft, cooking lines, prep stations), drive-thru configuration (lane count, stacking capacity for vehicles), kiosk count, counter service positions, and maximum cover count per daypart. This is the single source of truth for all physical capacity and layout attributes of a unit — governs brand standard compliance, throughput benchmarking, labor staffing ratios, health department permit compliance, and fire marshal occupancy limits.
